page_title: LEC 1-0 CAG | Lecce v Cagliari 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' 6:10 – the corner kicks stats.
90+7' The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
90+6' The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Substitution. Nikola Krstovic walks off the pitch and Ante Rebic (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
90+3' The resulting corner from Razvan Marin (Cagliari) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+3' Lecce will take a corner kick.
90+1' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+1' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) looks on in disbelief after missing his chance. He fires the rebound onto the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
89' Cagliari quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
88' 4:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
85' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
82' Substitution. Roberto Piccoli makes his way off the pitch and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
80' Half-chance! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack.
75' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Lameck Banda will be replaced by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
75' Luca Gotti has decided to substitute Frederic Guilbert and he is replaced by Gaby Jean (Lecce).
75' Here comes a substitution. Balthazar Pierret is given a rest as he is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
70' Michael Fabbri shows the yellow card to Razvan Marin (Cagliari) for a heavy challenge.
68' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alessandro Deiola is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
68' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi goes off the pitch and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) comes on.
67' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
65' The referee Michael Fabbri awards Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) a yellow card.
63' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

62' Lameck Banda (Lecce) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
61' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Lameck Banda (Lecce) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
60' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
59' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tete Morente (Lecce) will replace Remi Oudin.

54' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
53' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
48' Today's referee Michael Fabbri rightly decides to book Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) for his harsh tackle.
47' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
46' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) replacing Gabriele Zappa.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Prati trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Patrick Dorgu (Lecce). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
45+1' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), but referee Michael Fabbri must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sees a yellow card from Michael Fabbri after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
43' Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Remi Oudin (Lecce) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
42' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lecce are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

41' Cagliari slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
39' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
37' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
31' Lecce are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Lecce will take a throw-in.
29' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
27' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' 1 - 0 Gooal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Kialonda Gaspar. He makes it 1:0.
26' Lecce take a short corner kick.
24' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Fabbri ignores the protests.
22' The foul by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
19' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
16' The resulting corner from Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is cleared by the defence.

15' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the bar and ricochets away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
14' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' A great run by Lameck Banda (Lecce) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.

12' A cross from the side flies outside the box to Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). He attempts to score, but chooses power over accuracy which causes his projectile to go well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
10' Simone Scuffet is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Ylber Ramadani (Lecce). Easy save!
7' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
5' Remi Oudin (Lecce) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
4' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Fabbri.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
